Where we run

Port → Factory Routes

One road, run every week: from the two Karachi ports, up the country to the factory belt.

The upcountry run

Karachi Port & Port Qasim → Hyderabad → Sukkur → Multan → Lahore → Punjab & KPK.

Karachi Port
→ Factories

Import containers from KPT terminals to factory gates nationwide.

Port Qasim
→ Factories

Karachi

How it works

Three steps, port to gate

1 — Booking

Send your container details on WhatsApp or a call. We confirm the trailer and the lifting plan the same day.

2 — Lifting & Dispatch

Our trailer lifts the container from Karachi Port or Port Qasim and dispatches upcountry — you stay updated at every step.

3 — Factory Delivery

The container reaches your factory gate in Lahore, Punjab or KPK, with POD confirmed back to you.
